title: Ms L Jackson v Margaret Blackwood Housing Association Ltd: 4100986/2016
text:
The Judgment of the Tribunal is:- 

(1) To grant the respondents' application for reconsideration of the Judgment issued under Rule 21 of the Employment Tribunals (Constitution and Rules of Procedure) Regulations 2013 on 25 May 2016.

(2) To revoke the Judgment dated 25 May 2016.
description: Employment Tribunal decision of Judge Eccles on 29 July 2016.
